name: Gemma 3n E2B
notes: PARAMS vs ACTIVE IS THE WHOLE STORY HERE, and it is the one place in this set where the two numbers are deliberately different. params_b = 5.44B is the full safetensors count across text, vision, audio and per-layer-embedding (PLE) tables. active_params_b = 1.91B is Google's documented EFFECTIVE parameter load after PLE caching and parameter skipping. Google states standard execution loads over 5B. Recording 5.44B as 'the model' and calling it a 1.91B serving cost would be wrong: the weights still have to exist in memory even when skipped. SERVING CONSEQUENCE: the interesting mechanisms are PLE caching (per-layer embeddings precomputed to fast local storage and folded in per layer, trading RAM for IO), conditional parameter loading (vision and audio towers simply not loaded for text-only requests), and MatFormer nesting (the E2B parameters are a prefix of the E4B, so one checkpoint serves both sizes). These are IO- and memory-planning features, not FLOP features. KV: 30 * 2 * 256 * 2 * 2 bytes = 61,440 bytes/token = 60 KiB/token. Only 6 of 30 layers are full_attention and the local window is 512 tokens, so effective KV at 32k is far below 1.9 GiB. confidence 0.8: the 5.44B and 1.91B figures come from two different mechanisms (weight count vs Google's effective-load documentation) and are not directly comparable without the PLE caveat in notes.
